Read only at low confidence (ball hole (about 1.4 inch) with a white kicker plate, beside the ramp mouth), so left unplaced: The only ball-sized hole on the whitewood; the white disc is a smaller cup/plate inside a 65 px oval cutout. In production a red standup-style plate with a screw stands on this spot (production (440,575) maps to (469,627), about 30 px up-field of the cutout as for the other raised red targets), which could instead be a drop target; the VUK identification is by hole size only.
SECRET PASSAGE: not visible on either photo.
LEFT INNER ORBIT: left lane switch is hidden under wire guides in production and not distinguishable on the whitewood.

DROP TARGET: no drop target could be identified. The red standups seen in production are the Living Dead Girl pair, the one at the ramp mouth (51) and the one under the boombox (56); the drop target could be either of the last two.

Read only at low confidence (red standup target with a screw at the ramp mouth, left of the ramp's dark entry block), so left unplaced: Production shows a red square standup with a screw and a white mounting block at production (440,575) just left of the ramp entry. The homography is invalid at target height, so the position is the mapped face (469,627); its base is probably 25-35 px nearer the apron (about (465,655), over the VUK cutout). It could equally be the drop target.
